description: This file defines Express.js routes for an API gateway, handling authentication, user listing, inventory proxy, order creation, and notification sending, utilizing middleware and service functions.

methods.name: POST /auth/login
methods.description: Handles user login, returning a stub JWT token.

methods.name: GET /users
methods.description: Returns a list of users, protected by authentication and admin role.

methods.name: GET /inventory
methods.description: Proxies request to list inventory from business logic.

methods.name: POST /orders
methods.description: Creates an order by proxying to business logic.

methods.name: POST /notifications
methods.description: Sends a notification via the notification service.
